## Description

Returns all placed structures with the requested kind.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_structures_by_type (& self , kind : StructureKind) -> Vec < StructureInfo >
```

## Arguments

| `kind` | [`StructureKind`](../structures/structurekind.md) | `kind` argument passed as `StructureKind`. |

## SDK Example
